blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines–The bronze medal eluded the Philippine Blu Girls for the second straight time after falling to Chinese-Taipei, 12-2, in four innings as the women’s softball event of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games drew to a close on Saturday at Anjo Softball Ground. Hopes of a breakthrough podium finish were quickly dashed as Chinese Taipei erupted for four runs in the first inning and eight in the second, eventually securing the lopsided victory via mercy rule.
